blocks.goal: Extract the cohesive tablet-range widening responsibility while preserving the public Utils.widen methods as compatibility wrappers.

ops.details: Move findContaining(org.apache.accumulo.core.metadata.schema.Ample, org.apache.accumulo.core.data.TableId, org.apache.hadoop.io.Text) and the two widen methods' implementation into UtilsRangeWidening. Keep Utils.widen(org.apache.accumulo.core.metadata.schema.Ample, org.apache.accumulo.core.dataImpl.KeyExtent) and Utils.widen(org.apache.accumulo.core.metadata.schema.Ample, org.apache.accumulo.core.data.TableId, org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.zookeeper.LockRange, org.apache.accumulo.core.clientImpl.thrift.TableOperation, boolean) with their existing signatures and delegate to UtilsRangeWidening. This removes Utils's direct references to org.apache.accumulo.core.data.Key, org.apache.accumulo.core.data.PartialKey, java.util.Objects, and com.google.common.collect.MoreCollectors. The target gains only the new UtilsRangeWidening dependency, for an expected net Fan-Out reduction of three removed dependencies minus one introduced dependency, or two. org.apache.accumulo.core.dataImpl.KeyExtent, org.apache.accumulo.core.metadata.schema.Ample, org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.zookeeper.LockRange, org.apache.hadoop.io.Text, and related public signature dependencies remain and are not counted as removed.

outputs: Updated imports for the moved widening implementation and its compatibility wrappers
ops.details: Remove imports used only by the moved implementation from Utils and add the UtilsRangeWidening reference. Preserve imports required by the existing public method signatures and by other Utils methods.

blocks.goal: Extract HDFS-directory reservation behavior while preserving the existing public Utils reservation methods.

ops.details: Move the implementations of getSortedSetFromFile(org.apache.accumulo.manager.Manager, org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path, boolean), getSortedSplitsFromFile(org.apache.accumulo.server.ServerContext, org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path), reserveHdfsDirectory(org.apache.accumulo.manager.Manager, java.lang.String, org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.FateId), and unreserveHdfsDirectory(org.apache.accumulo.manager.Manager, java.lang.String, org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.FateId) into UtilsHdfsReservation, retaining public Utils methods with their existing signatures as compatibility wrappers. The HDFS reservation methods remove Utils's direct references to java.util.Base64 and org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.zookeeper.ZooReservation. The extracted file-parser methods retain their existing delegation to org.apache.accumulo.manager.tableOps.UtilsFileParser; therefore UtilsFileParser is not claimed as removed. The target gains only UtilsHdfsReservation, so the expected net Fan-Out reduction from this block is two removed dependencies minus one introduced dependency, or one. java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets remains required by getNextId in Utils.

outputs: Updated imports for the extracted HDFS reservation responsibility and compatibility wrappers
ops.details: Remove Base64 and ZooReservation imports from Utils after all direct calls are moved, add the UtilsHdfsReservation reference, and retain imports still required by the unchanged public signatures and remaining methods.
